name: Progress M-UM PAO
about: Progress M-UM PAO (2021-111A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M-SO), launched 2021 Nov 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Nov 24), held fixed
docked to S49044; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
